description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting, responsible for analyzing and correcting the nesting of HTML tokens to ensure they conform to the HTML element structure and constraints. It implements the execute() method which processes a list of tokens, validating and fixing their nesting based on definitions, exclusions, and child validation rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting
classes.description: A strategy class responsible for fixing the nesting of HTML tokens in a token list as per HTML specifications. It ensures elements are properly nested, manages exclusions, and validates child elements based on definitions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of HTML tokens to correct their nesting according to HTML rules, definitions, and exclusions. It adds implicit parent nodes, validates each node's children, handles exclusions, removes or replaces invalid nodes, and ensures proper nesting structure.
